ink.role: Primary brand navy. Headings, navigation, primary surfaces.

ink2.role: Lighter navy. Top of the navy gradient only.

ink3.role: Near-black navy. Bottom of the navy gradient only.

gold.role: Accessible gold. The only gold allowed as text on a light background.

gold2.role: Decorative gold. Rules, borders, gold on navy. Not body text on paper.

gold3.role: Highlight gold. The shine in the metal gradient.

gold4.role: Shadow gold. The dark edge of the metal gradient.

line.role: Hairline borders and dividers on paper.

display.stack: 'Playfair Display', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

sans.stack: 'Inter', 'Noto Sans Devanagari', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

devanagari.note: Fallback for Hindi codepoints in both stacks.
